name: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy

Optimal.Notes: A smooth, stable 60 fps at native resolution with modest TDP is the sweet spot for this game; the hardware is vastly overpowered for it. In-game option names are estimated from standard Unity quality presets as no authoritative list was found in sources.

profiles.Summary: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy is a lightweight Unity-based indie game with very modest GPU demands, running well within the Steam Deck's capabilities and easily hitting 60 fps at native resolution. No Deck-specific issues are known, and its Verified status means it works out of the box with no tweaks required.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the very low PC minimum requirements (Intel HD 4000) and the game's lightweight Unity engine. On first run, confirm the game reaches 60 fps without issue and reduce TDP further if battery life is a priority.

MaxBattery.Notes: At 4 W TDP the game runs comfortably at a locked 30 fps; the low GPU clock is more than sufficient for this lightweight Unity title. In-game option names are estimated from standard Unity quality presets as no authoritative list was found in sources.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Even at the highest settings this game barely stresses the Deck; 60 fps is trivially achieved and the TDP headroom is mostly wasted. In-game option names are estimated from standard Unity quality presets as no authoritative list was found in sources.

Optimal.Notes: Native 1280x800 at 60 fps is easily achieved given the game's minimal GPU demands; no upscaling needed. This is the recommended everyday profile for a great-looking, responsive experience.

profiles.Summary: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy is a lightweight 2D/3D indie game with very modest PC requirements, running effortlessly on the Steam Deck at high frame rates and low power draw. The game is Steam Deck Verified and plays well out of the box with default Proton.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Deck player reports were found; profiles are estimated from the game's very modest PC requirements (Intel HD 4000 minimum) and the Steam Deck hardware. On your first run, confirm the frame rate is stable and lower the TDP cap if the battery drains faster than expected.

MaxBattery.Notes: This game is extremely light on hardware; a 4 W TDP and a locked GPU clock are more than enough to hold 45 fps smoothly. In-game options are minimal — settings listed reflect typical Unity indie game options and may not all appear.

MaxPerformance.Notes: The OLED's 90 Hz mode is fully achievable given how lightweight this game is; the TDP headroom is given to the CPU for smooth physics and audio. Battery life drops significantly at 90 Hz, so plug in or switch to Optimal for longer sessions.
